pois.name: Fisketorget
pois.intro: Torget, eller torvet, er det sentrale torget i Bergen, som strekker seg fra Narvesen-kiosken Rundetårn i øst, med frukttorg, fisketorg og blomstertorg mot vest, er et torg innerst i Vågen med omsetning av fisk, skalldyr, bær, frukt og blomster, i tillegg til salgsboder med suvenirer og hurtigmat. Her arrangeres også bondens marked.

pois.name: Hordaland kunstsenter kafé
pois.description: Her finner du et rolig og avslappet miljø, der du kan spise og drikke godt. Vi har gratis internett.

pois.name: Bryggen
pois.intro: Bryggen, also known as Tyskebryggen, is a series of Hanseatic heritage commercial buildings lining up the eastern side of the Vågen harbour in the city of Bergen, Norway. Bryggen has been on the UNESCO list for World Cultural Heritage sites since 1979.

pois.name: Fantoft stavkirke
pois.intro: Fantoft Stave Church is a reconstructed stave church in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. The church is located in the Fana borough of the city of Bergen.

pois.name: Fløyfjellet
pois.intro: Fløyen or Fløyfjellet is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is one of the "seven city mountains" that surround the centre of the city of Bergen.

pois.name: Edvard Grieg Museum Troldhaugen
pois.openingHours: Jan-Apr: Mo-Su 10:00-16:00; May-Sep: Mo-Su 09:00-18:00; Oct-Dec: Mo-Su 10:00-16:00
pois.description: Tidligere bolig til komponisten Edvard Grieg
pois.intro: Troldhaugen is the former home of Norwegian composer Edvard Grieg and his wife Nina Grieg. Troldhaugen is located in Bergen, Norway and consists of the Edvard Grieg Museum, Grieg's villa, the hut where he composed music, and his and his wife's gravesite.

pois.name: Ulriken
pois.intro: Ulriken is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is the highest of the Seven Mountains that surround the city centre of Bergen.

pois.name: Gamlehaugen
pois.description: Tidligere bolig til statsminister Christian Michelsen
pois.intro: Gamlehaugen is a Royal Castle in Bergen, Norway, and the residence of the Norwegian royal family in the city. Gamlehaugen has a history that goes as far back as the Middle Ages, and the list of previous owners includes many of the wealthiest men in Bergen.

pois.name: Bergenhus festning
pois.intro: Bergenhus fortress is a fortress located in Bergen, Norway. Located at the entrance of Bergen harbour, the castle is one of the oldest and best preserved stone fortifications in Norway.

pois.name: Statsraad Lehmkuhl
pois.intro: Statsraad Lehmkuhl is a three-masted barque rigged sail training vessel owned and operated by the Statsraad Lehmkuhl Foundation. It is based in Bergen, Norway and contracted out for various purposes, including serving as a school ship for the Royal Norwegian Navy.

pois.name: Fløibanen, nedre stasjon;Fløibanen
pois.intro: Fløibanen is a funicular railway, owned by Fløibanen AS, in the Norwegian city of Bergen. It connects the city centre with the mountain of Fløyen, with its mountain walks and magnificent views of the city.

pois.name: Schøtstuene
pois.intro: Hanseatic Museum and Schøtstuene is a museum in the city of Bergen, Norway.

pois.name: Akvariet i Bergen
pois.openingHours: Sep-Apr: Mo-Su 10:00-18:00; May-Aug: Mo-Su 09:00-18:00; May 17 off; Dec 24-25 off; Dec 31 off
pois.intro: Bergen Aquarium is a public aquarium in Bergen, Norway. It is situated on the Nordnes peninsula and is one of Bergen's tourist attractions.

pois.name: Rundemanen
pois.intro: Rundemanen is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is considered one of the Seven Mountains which surround the city centre of Bergen, its elevation of 568 metres makes it the second highest of them all.

pois.name: Sandviksfjellet
pois.intro: Sandviksfjellet is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is one of the traditional seven mountains that surround the city centre of Bergen.

pois.name: Damsgårdsfjellet
pois.intro: Damsgårdsfjellet is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is one of the seven mountains surrounding the city center of Bergen.

pois.name: Løvstakken
pois.intro: Løvstakken is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is one of the Seven Mountains that surround the center of the city of Bergen.

pois.name: Håkonshallen
pois.intro: Die Håkonshalle ist ein Gebäude im Königshof in Bergen und ist Teil der Festung Bergenhus.

pois.name: Hanseatisk museum
pois.intro: Hanseatic Museum and Schøtstuene is a museum in the city of Bergen, Norway.

pois.name: Bryggens museum
pois.intro: Bryggens Museum is a museum located in Bergen, Norway. During 1955, parts of the historic district of Bryggen were ravaged by a fire.

pois.name: Bergen Sjøfartsmuseum
pois.openingHours: May-Sep Mo-Fr 10:00-16:00; May-Sep Sa,Su 10:00-17:00; Oct-Apr Fr-We 11:00-15:00; Oct-Apr Th 11:00-18:00
pois.intro: Das Schifffahrtsmuseum Bergen wurde 1962 errichtet und zuvor vom norwegischen Architekten Per Grieg entworfen. Es wurde in einem monumentalen Stil mit soliden Steinmauern gebaut.

pois.name: Norges Fiskerimuseum
pois.intro: Het Norges Fiskerimuseum is een museum in Bergen over de geschiedenis van de Noorse visserij en visverwerkende industrie. In het museum zijn onder meer vissersnetten, boten en vistuig tentoongesteld.

pois.name: Rosenkrantztårnet
pois.intro: Bergenhus fortress is a fortress located in Bergen, Norway. Located at the entrance of Bergen harbour, the castle is one of the oldest and best preserved stone fortifications in Norway.

pois.name: Bergen Lepramuseum
pois.intro: Das St. Jørgens Hospital war eine mittelalterliche Stiftung in der Stadt Bergen in Norwegen, wurde bis in die Mitte des 20.

pois.name: Gamle Bergen
pois.intro: Das Museum Gamle Bergen ist ein Freilichtmuseum in Bergen in Norwegen. Es befindet sich im Stadtteil Sandviken.

pois.name: Permanenten
pois.intro: Permanenten, formerly the West Norway Museum of Decorative Art, also referred to as KODE 1, is a museum in Bergen, Norway. The museum is part of the KODE Art Museums and Composer Homes and was originally established in 1887 at the initiative of Johan Bøgh.

pois.name: Tårnfoten
pois.intro: Nonneseter Abbey was a Cistercian nunnery in Bergen, Norway. A small part of the former abbey church remains in use as a chapel, the Nonneseter kapell.

pois.name: Torgallmenningen
pois.intro: Torgallmenningen, previously written Torvalmenningen, is the main square of Bergen, Norway.

pois.name: DMG GALLERY
pois.description: DMG Gallery is a contemporary art gallery by David Matej Goljat, presenting original drawings, paintings, prints and limited editions. His work is defined by a distinctive living line and an exceptional sense of colour and composition.

pois.name: Det Akademiske Kvarter
pois.intro: Det Akademiske Kvarter, more commonly known as Kvarteret, is a student cultural center in Bergen, Norway. It is situated on Olav Kyrres gate in the center of Bergen, within walking distance of both the main shopping areas and the University of Bergen.

pois.openingHours: Mo-Th 08:00-14:30; Fr 08:00-14:00; Sa-Su off; Jun 21-Aug 02 off
pois.description: Sammen kantine for studenter og lokale

pois.name: Bergen Storsenter
pois.intro: Bergen Storsenter is the largest shopping centre in central Bergen, Norway, with a turnover of 1,024 billion Norwegian krone in 2002.

pois.name: Motehuset Sundt
pois.intro: Das Kaufhaus Sundt ist ein denkmalgeschütztes Kaufhaus in der norwegischen Stadt Bergen.

pois.name: Galleriet

pois.name: Telegrafen
pois.intro: Telegrafbygningen, eller Telegrafen kjøpesenter, ligger i Starvhusgaten 4 i Bergen. Bygget ligger sentralt til med hovedfasaden vendt mot Byparken Terminal, Byparken, musikkpaviljongen og KODE 1.

pois.name: Samleren
pois.description: Kjøper og selger vinylplater og CD-er

pois.name: Hordaland kunstsenter bokhandel
pois.description: Tidsskrifter og fagbøker knyttet til samtidskunstfeltet, antologier og tekstsamlinger som diskuterer viktige tema for dagens kunstproduksjon, kunstinstitusjonen og kuratorisk praksis.

pois.name: Sverresborg
pois.intro: Sverresborg is a fortress and former castle situated in the Norwegian city of Bergen.

pois.name: Frederiksberg fort
pois.intro: Fredriksberg fort is a Norwegian fortification located at the highest point of Nordnes in Bergen.

pois.name: Blåmanen
pois.intro: Blåmanen is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is one of the seven mountains that surround the centre of the city of Bergen.

pois.name: Muséhagen
pois.intro: For Bergens botaniske hage se Arboretet og Botanisk hage Muséhagen, Muséplass 3, er en botanisk hage ved Universitetsmuseet i Bergens naturhistoriske avdeling på Nygårdshøyden i Bergen. I dag er Muséhagen, Arboretet og Botanisk hage samlet under navnet Universitetshagene.

pois.name: Lyderhorn
pois.intro: Lyderhorn is a mountain in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is one of "De syv fjell", the seven mountains surrounding the city centre of Bergen.

pois.name: Laksevåg Senter
pois.intro: Laksevåg senter er et kjøpesenter i Laksevåg bydel, ca. fem minutters kjøring vest for Bergen sentrum.

pois.name: Koengen
pois.intro: Koengen is an outdoor concert venue in the city centre of Bergen, Norway. The concert venue has a capacity of approximately 23,500 people.

pois.name: Byparken
pois.intro: Byparken is een park in het centrum van de Noorse stad Bergen. Het park ligt aan de westkant van de achthoekige vijver Lille Lungegårdsvannet en loopt door in oostelijke richting langs de oevers van de vijver.

pois.name: Xhibition
pois.intro: Xhibition er et kjøpesenter i Småstrandgaten i Bergen sentrum, som åpnet i 2004, etter totalrenovering, lokalisert i den gamle bygningen for hovedpostkontoret i Bergen. Bygget var oppført i 1956.

pois.name: Nordnesparken
pois.intro: The Nordnes Park is a public park in Bergen Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. The park is located near the centre of the city of Bergen on the northwestern end of the Nordnes peninsula.

terminalResolution.notes: Skolten, Bontelabo, and Jekteviken are all Bergen cruise berths; the rest are local ferry stops.
